articles.title: Anti-trafficking group says Clarity Act's Section 604 could weaken accountability
articles.snippet: An anti-human trafficking advocate said a Clarity Act provision could weaken accountability despite existing criminal laws.

articles.title: Ether, XRP and dogecoin lead a broad crypto selloff as tech stocks tumble
articles.snippet: Bitcoin slipped near $58,000 before recovering, and CF Benchmarks says the $50,000 to $60,000 zone is where buyers have always stepped in.

articles.title: Spain regulator rules out extension for non-MiCA compliant crypto companies
articles.snippet: Carlos San Basilio said that “there will be no exceptions ​or extensions” to the MiCA deadline requiring crypto exchanges offering services to EU-based users to be licensed.

articles.title: Bitcoin makes first sub-$60K close since Q3 2024 as tech stocks enter ‘deep bear market’
articles.snippet: Bitcoin risked turning $60,000 into resistance as BTC price weakness persisted following another tech-driven sell-off in Asian stock markets.

articles.title: Polymarket hit by $2.9M theft, users to be refunded
articles.snippet: Polymarket said it contained the compromise and removed the affected dependency after attackers injected a malicious script into its frontend.
